jessica_sales: Anne (DeltaSurge) - livestream demo dropping, client sees JSON parse errors mid-stream.
anne_customer: Android WebView. Error: Unexpected end of input. HAR uploaded: https://files.example/ds-har-06.zip
paul_dev: reproduced on our side; chunks split inside JSON objects. Webview tries to parse each data arrival.
omar_se: do they have an edge proxy? that can re-chunk responses.
anne_customer: yes, internal edge proxy only.
liam_infra: recent runtime change toggled auto-flush after N tokens (2026-02-18). could cause flush between SSE data lines.
nick_support: quick fixes: 1) client buffer until full SSE event delimiter (

) - small patch; 2) revert auto-flush optimizer; 3) offer Dedicated trial to bypass proxy.
omar_se: I can ship a tiny SDK wrapper for webview to reassemble fragments. snippet I will share in PR.
paul_dev: please send prebuilt artifact if possible; we'll test tomorrow AM PST.
liam_infra: I'll push a staging revert and add SSE_WRITE logs (id,len,flushed) to trace mid-event flushes.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: staging/runtime-revert requested by @liam_infra - ETA 20m
jessica_sales: I'll open a Dedicated trial and give short-term elevated quota while triage proceeds. Also capturing compliance questions from the customer.
nick_support: follow-ups assigned: @omar_se SDK PR + artifact, @liam_infra runtime revert + logs, @jessica_sales trial/quote, customer to validate client patch.
anne_customer: thanks, team. Paul will try the patch tomorrow.
